## [1.28.0](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/compare/v1.27.1...v1.28.0) (2026-09-22)

### Bug Fixes

* **iJiami:** stop patched MovieBox 4.0.03 dying at launch on the ffdfe477 packer build ([2f5f048](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/2f5f048909c3da55ea8ca38bc4c3f39d1e300155))
* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** keep unlocking premium when the app renames its member methods ([8d5b441](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/8d5b4416e5731ad9b180a78977bc36835306e16a))

### New Features

* **AtloMaps - Unlock premium:** unlock custom map sources, navigation settings and backup restore ([65f7f98](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/65f7f9812145f2f6f85e50e3e17955872a82013c))
* **iJiami:** select payload methods by the strings they load and the methods they call ([1330bac](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/1330bac70685b3f827caac9e887422f8bb95dd47))
* **MovieBox:** support 4.0.03.0918.03 ([ed6f660](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/ed6f660a9038d5a3336f04ac319797f25227e3ad))
* **Proton Pass - AMOLED dark theme:** replace dark theme background with pure black ([29d9835](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/29d98352c2293fdc9143623f25fa6bee2ff10f06))
* **Proton Pass - Hide promotional messages:** hide promotional banners, offers and pop-up messages ([7bf244a](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/7bf244a44b3c7168ae6421a7c4aec004e44d8eea))
* **Proton Pass - Hide upgrade promotions:** hide Upgrade buttons and welcome offer after sign-in ([4a98d01](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/4a98d0130ffef0f725e67beb895e7f28280f5ca1))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Grants the pro entitlement, which removes the ads and the paywalled tools.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks running and logging workouts, progress tracking and personal records (AI workout generation is not included).

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches.name: Custom accent color
patches.description: Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.

patches.name: Hide upgrade promotions
patches.description: Hides the top-bar upgrade button, promotional sidebar rows and the auto-delete upgrade banner in Trash and Spam. Keeps the Empty trash and Empty spam buttons.

patches.name: Remove 'Sent from' signature
patches.description: Removes the 'Sent from Proton Mail' signature from emails.

patches.name: Remove free accounts limit
patches.description: Removes the limit for maximum free accounts logged in.

patches.name: Scheduled Trash and Spam deletion
patches.description: Deletes all messages in Trash and Spam on separate configurable schedules. Deleted messages cannot be recovered.

patches.name: Unlock custom time picker
patches.description: Enables picking a custom date and time when snoozing conversations and scheduling messages.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks the custom map sources, navigation settings and backup restore. Premium map packages are not included.

patches.name: Hide membership upselling
patches.description: Hides the membership promotion on the Home screen and the free trial bottom sheet.

patches.name: Open Library on launch
patches.description: Opens the Library tab instead of Home on launch. Applies only while signed in.

patches.name: All-In-One
patches.description: Enables video playback and downloads, removes ads and upsell prompts, bypasses the region block, and unlocks the hidden Laboratory menu. Requires Android 10 or later.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Adds a pure black option to the dark theme.

patches.name: Dark theme
patches.description: Renders the app's dark theme and adds it to the settings.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium and removes ads.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted listings and the "with Ads" label from search results.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium servers and removes ads, upgrade banners, the launch paywall and the Android TV sign-in screen.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, and native ads.

patches.name: Block telemetry
patches.description: Blocks the Umeng, ByteDance and ad network analytics endpoints.

patches.name: Hide rating dialog
patches.description: Removes the prompt asking for a store review.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks the paid drawing, annotation and measurement tools, and removes ads.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Stops installs, sessions and in-app events from reaching AppsFlyer.

patches.name: Hide Shorts
patches.description: Hides the 1Weather Shorts card from the Today screen.

patches.name: Hide Skyla
patches.description: Hides the Skyla AI assistant, its prompts and the Summarize buttons.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium and removes ads.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black. Disables over-the-air updates that would restore the original background.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks downloading every surah, lyrics and tafsir, Android Auto, background playback controls, and insights.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks ad removal, light theme, custom images, list view types, quick ratings, and transparent widgets. The News feed is not included.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the light theme with a pure black dark theme. Requires Android 13 or later.

patches.name: Bypass session expiry
patches.description: Stops the security prompt that signs the account out.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops crash and error reports from reaching Sentry.

patches.name: Disable usage tracking
patches.description: Stops app usage events from being uploaded. Local usage tracking remains enabled.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks the energy schedule, habit tools, smart alarm and progress insights. Requires a RISE account.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Stops the install identifier from reaching Expo and usage events from reaching Google. Disables OTA updates.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks unlimited move views, goals and move cards, manual sync, earlier library updates and card customization. Disables OTA updates.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables analytics and crash reporting.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: Unlock pro
patches.description: Unlocks task lists, callouts, app lock, and the notebook, tag, colour and reminder limits. Requires a signed-in account. The server still enforces storage, attachment size, monographs and SMS 2FA.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the adverts shown between search results.

patches.name: Disable rating prompt
patches.description: Stops the Google Play rating prompt from appearing.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium, removes ads and the free session time limit.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks the premium music channels, on-demand playback and track skipping. Requires a signed-in account.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all features and removes the ads.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium content and skips the free trial screen.

patches.name: Remove nags
patches.description: Removes the rate this app dialog and the promotional dialogs shown on startup.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds an option to hide banner, interstitial, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Inspect AI requests
patches.description: Shows the network calls an AI tool makes, such as HTTP requests and Firebase uploads, and keeps a log, so you can watch your photo fly to China or the US.

patches.name: Show AI progress
patches.description: Reads the current stage off the real network activity instead of the fake progress bar InShot ships.

patches.name: Speed up AI tools
patches.description: Shortens the AI tool wait by polling for the result more often and uploading the photo in larger chunks.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Adds an option to unlock the pro tools, remove the export watermark and hide the upgrade prompts.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches.name: Hide promotional messages
patches.description: Hides promotional banners, offers and pop-up messages.

patches.name: Hide upgrade promotions
patches.description: Hides the Upgrade buttons, upgrade prompts and the welcome offer after signing in. Plan limits still apply.

patches.name: Unlock full version
patches.description: Unlocks the Off-Road Explorer features gated behind activation.

patches.name: Remove rating prompts
patches.description: Removes the prompts asking for a rating.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium, removes ads and skips the upgrade screens.
